LanguageData.Gun_Zastava_M70_RWP.description: A reliable assault rifle with a wooden frame, the Zastava M70 offers dependable mid-range firepower. Known for its durability and accuracy, it is well-suited for both offensive engagements and defensive positions. Medium rate of fire with solid stopping power; a versatile choice for skilled marksmen.
